cleanup.guest: python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent remove plain >/dev/null; python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent remove oldmode >/dev/null; python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent remove oldallow >/dev/null; python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent remove exposed >/dev/null; python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent remove oauth >/dev/null; rm -rf /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0 /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.3.x /opt/opute-e2e/guest/neutralprobe.py; true

description: The single serving profile of 0.4.0: an agent with only an id and a token; agents that still carry the old mode and mutation variables; a host exposed on purpose; and OAuth machine clients from operator configuration.

inputs.agent: the 0.4.0 candidate's release binary (the one the dev VM runs), started by the journey with `serve` and explicit settings

pass.equals: Error: mutations are disabled; set OPUTE_HOST_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true

requirements.scenario: Started with only an id and a token: it serves on 127.0.0.1:3014 with read tools only, and its journal, tools/list and help name no Platform identifier
A host exposed on purpose (bind 0.0.0.0, port 3004, mutations true) serves there with mutations admitted and the same catalog
The effective bind, port and mutation policy are logged once

pass.equals: Error: mutations are disabled; set OPUTE_HOST_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true

requirements.scenario: Mutations not enabled: the refusal names OPUTE_HOST_ALLOW_MUTATIONS

pass.equals: Error: mutations are disabled; set OPUTE_HOST_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true

requirements.scenario: A host that still carries OPUTE_AGENT_MODE=platform and no other setting starts exactly as one without it, and nothing it prints mentions the variable

pass.equals: Error: mutations are disabled; set OPUTE_HOST_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true

requirements.requirement: Every orchestrator is an ordinary client
requirements.scenario: No OAuth clients configured: no machine client is provisioned, and the bearer works

requirements.requirement: Every orchestrator is an ordinary client
requirements.scenario: A client listed in OPUTE_OAUTH_CLIENTS gets a credential and a working token; the earlier built-in client id is unknown; once unlisted, its credential and token are gone

steps.guest: gzip -dc /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/host-agent-linux-x64.gz > /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent && chmod 0755 /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent && /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent --version

install -d -o opute -g opute /tmp/e2e-agents /tmp/e2e-agents/plain /tmp/e2e-agents/plain/home && systemd-run --quiet --collect --unit=e2e-agent-plain --uid=opute --gid=opute --property=Restart=no --property=PrivateNetwork=yes --setenv='HOME=/tmp/e2e-agents/plain/home' --setenv='OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-plain' --setenv='MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:plain}' /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent serve && for i in $(seq 120); do nsenter -t $(systemctl show -p MainPID --value e2e-agent-plain) -n curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3014/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; nsenter -t $(systemctl show -p MainPID --value e2e-agent-plain) -n curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3014/health
nsenter -t $(systemctl show -p MainPID --value e2e-agent-plain) -n ss -ltnH 'sport = :3014' | awk '{print $4}'

nsenter -t $(systemctl show -p MainPID --value e2e-agent-plain) -n python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/neutralprobe.py summary --port 3014 --token '${SECRET:plain}' --unit e2e-agent-plain --binary /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent
test ! -e /tmp/e2e-agents/plain/home/.config/opute-e2e/n1.txt
ls /tmp/e2e-agents/plain/home/.config/opute/instances
ls /tmp/e2e-agents/plain/home/.config/opute/instances/standalone/state/credentials

install -d -o opute -g opute /tmp/e2e-agents /tmp/e2e-agents/oldmode /tmp/e2e-agents/oldmode/home && systemd-run --quiet --collect --unit=e2e-agent-oldmode --uid=opute --gid=opute --property=Restart=no --property=PrivateNetwork=yes --setenv='HOME=/tmp/e2e-agents/oldmode/home' --setenv='OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-oldmode' --setenv='MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:plain}' --setenv='OPUTE_AGENT_MODE=platform' /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent serve && for i in $(seq 120); do nsenter -t $(systemctl show -p MainPID --value e2e-agent-oldmode) -n curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3014/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; nsenter -t $(systemctl show -p MainPID --value e2e-agent-oldmode) -n curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3014/health
nsenter -t $(systemctl show -p MainPID --value e2e-agent-oldmode) -n ss -ltnH 'sport = :3014' | awk '{print $4}'

nsenter -t $(systemctl show -p MainPID --value e2e-agent-oldmode) -n python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/neutralprobe.py summary --port 3014 --token '${SECRET:plain}' --unit e2e-agent-oldmode --binary /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent
ls /tmp/e2e-agents/oldmode/home/.config/opute/instances

install -d -o opute -g opute /tmp/e2e-agents /tmp/e2e-agents/oldallow /tmp/e2e-agents/oldallow/home && systemd-run --quiet --collect --unit=e2e-agent-oldallow --uid=opute --gid=opute --property=Restart=no --property=PrivateNetwork=yes --setenv='HOME=/tmp/e2e-agents/oldallow/home' --setenv='OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-oldallow' --setenv='MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:plain}' --setenv='OPUTE_STANDALONE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true' /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent serve && for i in $(seq 120); do nsenter -t $(systemctl show -p MainPID --value e2e-agent-oldallow) -n curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3014/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; nsenter -t $(systemctl show -p MainPID --value e2e-agent-oldallow) -n curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3014/health

nsenter -t $(systemctl show -p MainPID --value e2e-agent-oldallow) -n python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/neutralprobe.py summary --port 3014 --token '${SECRET:plain}' --unit e2e-agent-oldallow --binary /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent

install -d -o opute -g opute /tmp/e2e-agents /tmp/e2e-agents/exposed /tmp/e2e-agents/exposed/home && systemd-run --quiet --collect --unit=e2e-agent-exposed --uid=opute --gid=opute --property=Restart=no --setenv='HOME=/tmp/e2e-agents/exposed/home' --setenv='OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-exposed' --setenv='MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:exposed}' --setenv='HOST_MCP_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0' --setenv='HOST_MCP_PORT=3004' --setenv='OPUTE_HOST_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true' /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent serve && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3004/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3004/health
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py listen 3004
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/neutralprobe.py summary --port 3004 --token '${SECRET:exposed}' --unit e2e-agent-exposed --binary /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent
cat /tmp/e2e-agents/exposed/home/.config/opute-e2e/n1.txt

install -d -o opute -g opute /tmp/e2e-agents /tmp/e2e-agents/oauth /tmp/e2e-agents/oauth/home && systemd-run --quiet --collect --unit=e2e-agent-oauth --uid=opute --gid=opute --property=Restart=no --setenv='HOME=/tmp/e2e-agents/oauth/home' --setenv='OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-oauth' --setenv='MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:oauth}' --setenv='HOST_MCP_PORT=3051' --setenv='OPUTE_OAUTH_CLIENTS=ci-runner' /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent serve && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3051/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3051/health
ls /tmp/e2e-agents/oauth/home/.config/opute/instances/standalone/state/credentials

python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/neutralprobe.py oauth --port 3051 --client ci-runner --cred /tmp/e2e-agents/oauth/home/.config/opute/instances/standalone/state/credentials/ci-runner.json --save /tmp/e2e-agents/oauth/token
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/neutralprobe.py oauth --port 3051 --client opute-mcp-host --secret not-a-secret
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent stop oauth

install -d -o opute -g opute /tmp/e2e-agents /tmp/e2e-agents/oauth /tmp/e2e-agents/oauth/home && systemd-run --quiet --collect --unit=e2e-agent-oauth --uid=opute --gid=opute --property=Restart=no --setenv='HOME=/tmp/e2e-agents/oauth/home' --setenv='OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-oauth' --setenv='MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:oauth}' --setenv='HOST_MCP_PORT=3051' /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.0/opute-host-agent serve && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3051/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3051/health
ls /tmp/e2e-agents/oauth/home/.config/opute/instances/standalone/state/credentials
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/neutralprobe.py reuse --port 3051 --token-file /tmp/e2e-agents/oauth/token
